notes: Much faster, reliable rendering on Mac — removed a speech-analysis step that could make renders take many minutes, and capped render duration so a render can never stall. Videos render quickly and always play. Stop now cancels the current render instantly, and the time-remaining countdown is accurate. Windows is unchanged. Still includes Scheduling, Calendar, Analytics, AutoSubmitter and Accounts, plus a different cover on every video and cleaner audio.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI.
